evidence.text:
cd /app/astropy && git commit --author="openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>" -m "Fix separability matrix computation for nested CompoundModels

The _cstack function was incorrectly setting all values to 1 instead of
preserving the existing separability matrix when processing nested
compound models like Pix2Sky_TAN() & (Linear1D(10) & Linear1D(5)).

This fix changes line 245 in separable.py to preserve the computed
separability matrix instead of overwriting it with ones.

Includes regression test to prevent this issue from reoccurring."
